title: Cortex TaskEnqueueRequest (DRAFT v0)
description: The canonical task-enqueue payload any Surface or harness POSTs to agent-fabric's POST /v1/intents (with /cortex/enqueue retained as a compatibility route). agent-fabric validates this shape, mints the task/intent/session identifiers, preserves home-conversation lineage, returns a durable binding immediately, and runs the task in-process on the dynamic workflow engine. Per ADR-0014 the shape is authored once here and imported by every consumer; agent-fabric NEVER redefines it. Status: DRAFT v0; v0->v1 is gated on a real end-to-end home-conversation -> child -> verified receipt round-trip. Bump $id on breaking changes.

source.description: Originating surface or harness identifier. Clarifications route back here. This is deliberately an open, validated identifier so new providers do not require a contract release.

description.description: Full instruction for the executing agent. Becomes TaskEnvelope.prompt; the spine's cortex.refine.punchup may rewrite it into refined_prompt.

project.description: Project routing identifier, including dynamically discovered projects such as crest. Maps to a project manifest and Mnemos container root and is carried through decomposition.

tier.description: Complexity tier. Drives whether the enqueue starts a single dispatch or a multi-step dynamic workflow ('complex' => engine), and seeds the model router's tier. Mirrors RouteDecision.tier / TaskEnvelope.complexity.

assigned_agent.description: Optional explicit executor override. Lifts the TaskEnvelope.assigned_agent enum verbatim. null => the spine/Maestro routes.

priority.description: Business priority for queue ordering. Lifts the WorkRequestPriority enum verbatim.

due_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC deadline. Advisory; the spine may use it for queue ordering / escalation.

context_url.description: Optional pointer to source context (mnemos://, repo://, file://, https://). Becomes a TaskEnvelope.context_refs entry.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key, stable across retries. When set, agent-fabric SHOULD dedupe; when null the server mints the TaskEnvelope.id and dispatch_id fresh.

root_conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for the supervising home conversation. Every child spawned from that conversation preserves this value.

parent_session_id.description: Immediate parent session identifier. For a root request this is normally the home-conversation session.

parent_task_id.description: Immediate parent task identifier when this intent is a decomposed child.

memory_scope.description: Canonical Mnemos container scope. Authorization is still enforced server-side; this is a routing claim, not an access grant.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkable completion conditions that an independent verifier evaluates before the task can be reported complete.

artifact_refs.description: Existing artifacts or output destinations that must remain joined to this task.

budget.description: Owner- or project-bounded inner execution budget. It may narrow but never expand the active policy's hard outer limits.

policy_version.description: Human-readable constitution/policy version active when the intent was accepted.

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the active machine-readable policy manifest.

judge_alias.description: Optional intent-punchup judge model alias. Controls only the classifier/synthesizer judge seat; lane execution remains routed by Maestro. Surfaces auto mode resolves live availability before POSTing a concrete alias.
